RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the November 20, 2002/Kartika 29, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministries:  Coal and Mines; Defence; Home Affairs; Non-Conventional
Energy Sources; Power; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions—20
7
Rehabilitation camps in Gujarat
*21. DR. ABRAR AHMED:
SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA:
 Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether all the families living in
various rehabilitation camps in Gujarat after
Godhra incident have since gone back to
their native homes; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Stationing NSG’s at all State
capitals
*22.  DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that several people
died in terrorist attack on Akshardham
Temple in Gujarat recently (September,
2002);
(b) the time taken by NSG commandos
to reach Ahmedabad from Delhi and start
the operation; and
(c) whether Government propose to
station NSGs at all State capitals to
tackle such terrorists’ attacks without
wasting time in flight for their movements
from Delhi?
Stagnation of underground mining
*23. SHRI GAYA SINGH:
SHRI J. CHITHARANJAN:
 Will the Minister of COAL AND
MINES  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
underground mining of coal has stagnated
over a decade resulting in increase in coal
imports;
(b) if so, the details of the production
from underground coal mines in the country
during the last ten years and imports of coal
during those years; and
(c) whether Government have plans to
increase production of coal from
underground mines; if so, the details thereof?
Drinking water projects in Orissa
*24. SHRI RAMACHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of
RURAL DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of projects taken up in
Orissa under Rajiv Gandhi National
Drinking Water Mission;
(b) the present status of work on the
projects; and

(c) the fresh steps taken by Government
for early completion of the projects?
Joint Indo-Russian probe into failure
of R.25 engines of MIG-21
*25. SHRI K. NATWAR SINGH:
SHRI P. PRABHAKAR REDDY:
 Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Russian experts
have joined the probe into the failure of the
R.25 engines of the MIG-21 alongwith
technical experts from the Indian Air Force
and Hindustan Aeronautics Limited;
(b) if so, whether a senior Russian
official has indicated that the sub-standard
spare parts was one of the reasons for the
high number of MIG-21 crashes in India in
recent years;
(c) if so, whether any inquiry has been
conducted by both Indian and Russian
Governments about the defective parts
supplied to India; and
(d) if so, what is the outcome of these
inquiries?
Employment for educated unemployed
youth in Assam
*26. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the details of steps taken by
Government to provide and create
employment opportunities for educated
unemployed youths in the rural areas of
Assam during the last three years;
(b) the details of financial allocation made
for the purpose during this period;
(c) the achievements of Government in
this regard; and
(d) the financial allocation proposed to
be made by Government for this purpose
during the Tenth Five Year Plan?
Re-deployment of troops from
International Border
*27. SHRI C. O. POULOSE:
SHRI HARENDRA SINGH
MALIK:
 Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) what were the objectives for the
deployment of troops on the International
Border;
(b) whether the deployment of troops
achieved its objectives;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) whether Government’s decision to
re-deploy the troops from International
Border indicate the improvement in the
situation which necessitated the deployment
of the troops?
Collapse of Western Grid
*28. SHRI GHULAM NABI AZAD:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
 Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether in the wake of the collapse
of the Western Grid on 30th July, 2002, the
Union Government had called a meeting of
State Chief Ministers on 5th August, 2002;
(b) if so, what were the main points
discussed;
(c) whether any probe was ordered on
the grid failure;
(d) if so, what was the outcome of the
probe; and

9
WIN2\SESSION\3687RS-QUES 9
(e) what are the steps being taken to see
that such grid failure does not take place
again?
Winding up of NTC mills
*29. SHRI V. V. RAGHAVAN:
SHRI J. CHITHARANJAN:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have decided to wind up 39 NTC mills by
December this year;
(b) if so, the names of these mills and
the number of employees employed therein;
and
(c) the details of the wage arrears and
other statutory dues to the employees and
the steps being taken for clearing the dues
and also for the payment of VRS
compensation to the employees?

Total number of questions—74
32
Sharing of revenue received from
minings with States
†139. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of COAL AND MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
share the revenue received from minings
with the States; and
(b) if so, by when, the final decision in
this regard is likely to be taken?
VRS in BALCO
†140. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of COAL AND MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-item captioned
"V.R.S. Abhi Lo Aur Bhugtan 10 Saal Main"
appeared at page 11 of Rashtriya Sahara
dated 4th August, 2002;
(b) if so, Government's reaction thereto;
and
(c) the steps being taken by Government
to protect the interest of the employees of
BALCO?
Families displaced due to acquisition
of land by MCL
141. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of COAL AND MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have made any
estimate on the number of families displaced
due to the acquisition land by Mahanadi
Coalfield Limited in various coal bearing
areas in Orissa;
(b) whether Government have provided
proper rehabilitation and compensation to
those displaced persons; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Coal production at Talcher coal field
142. SHRI RAMACHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of COAL
AND MINES be pleased to state:
(a) the quantity of coal produced during
last year at Talcher coal-field;
(b) whether a new company is proposed
to be established at Talcher, if so by when;
and
(c) the reasons of establishing a new
company at Talcher?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

MIG crashes
143. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA:
DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of MIG-21 crashes in
India during the last four years;
(b) the number of pilots and other lives
lost in the crashes;
(c) the amount lost on account of loss of
property; and
(d) the action taken to replace these
planes with better varieties immediately?
Withdrawal of troops from the
borders
†144. SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to withdraw troops deployed on the borders
back to their barracks;
(b) if so, the period for which the troops
were deployed on the borders; and
(c) the additional amount Government
had to spent for such deployment?
High altitudes training for armed forces
145. PROF. M. SANKARA-
LINGAM:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
MISS MABEL REBELLO:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to give
exposure on skiing training in the Swiss
Alps and high altitudes, to men of armed
forces, if so, details thereof and whether
this is on reciprocal basis;
(b) whether men in uniform have also
got such training in Austria or other
countries, if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether it is also proposed to set up
modernized high altitude training schools
in our country utilizing the services of trained
Army officials, if so, the details of this
project?
Finalisation of AJT deal
146. SHRI K. KALAVENKATA
RAO:
SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of Advance Jet Trainers
being inducted in the Indian Air Force;
(b) whether the deal has been finalised;
and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Weaponry defence budget vis-a-vis
total defence budget
147. MISS MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
refer to reply to Unstarred Question 779
given in the Rajya Sabha on the 24th July,
2002 and state the figures for the last three
years annually of the percentage of weaponry
defence budget of the total defence
budget?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Acquisition of flight simulators for
training fighter pilots
148. SHRI HARENDRA SINGH
MALIK: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Indian Air
Force is using fights simulators to train its
fighter pilots;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government propose to
acquire advanced fighter jet simulators
equivalent to acquiring advanced jet trainers;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Supply of defective Sukhoi 30 MKI
spaces
†149. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether a case of supply of defective
spare parts to India for Sukhoi MKI Planes
being build under joint collaboration of India
and Russia by the Russian ordnance
factories, have come to the notice of
Government;
(b) if so, whether quality of military
equipments is checked at the time of its
import;
(c) if so, the agency which carried out
such quality check
